# YouDJ

> > YouDJ is a free, cross-platform online DJ software featuring AutoSync and AutoBPM for beginners to create mixes in the browser or on mobile devices.

YouDJ offers both web-based and downloadable DJ mixing software across iOS, Android, Windows, and Mac platforms. The platform supports multiple payment methods and provides tiered upgrade options for users ranging from bedroom DJs to advanced producers.

## Key Topics

- AutoSync
- AutoBPM
- Online DJ mixer
- Cross-platform

## Getting Started

- [YouDJ - Online DJ Software](https://you.dj): YouDJ homepage: free online DJ mixer with AutoSync, AutoBPM features
- [Free DJ Software](https://you.dj/free-dj-software): YouDJ free online DJ software with AutoSync, AutoBPM for beginners
- [Download DJ Software](https://you.dj/download-dj-software): Download YouDJ DJ software for iOS, Android, Windows, and Mac

## Pricing & Upgrades

- [Upgrade Your DJ Level](https://you.dj/upgrade): YouDJ upgrade pricing tiers with PayPal, Stripe, Google Pay options
- [Level 1 - Beginner Tier](https://you.dj/level1): YouDJ Level 1 entry tier for bedroom DJs with payment methods
- [Level 2 - Intermediate Tier](https://you.dj/level2): YouDJ Level 2 mid-tier pricing with feature comparison and discounts
- [Level 3 - Advanced Tier](https://you.dj/level3): YouDJ Level 3 pricing tier with advanced features and payment options
